text:
mia (AE): FYI @oliver - Peakline (EU financial) escalated. POC blocked on two gov-critical asks: 1) EU region token quota is too low for their 48h stress run, 2) they require BYO-KMS with HSM attestation + SOC2 evidence before exec sign-off. also pricing question around burst vs sustained for >1B tokens/day. can we get an exec unblock?
arnav (SE): TL;DR from customer call: quota increase needed to run their ingest+eval pipeline, and legal wants a KMS attestation doc. they called out: no data plane egress outside eu-west-1 and must rotate keys via their KMS.
sofia (Solutions Eng): Technical notes: We can pin them to eu-west-1 Dedicated nodes. Quota bump is ops work — current pool limits per-tenant. BYO-KMS flow exists (VPC + External KMS), but HSM attestation is manual: we'll need audit logs and an HSM cert from their KMS provider.
sofia (Solutions Eng): snippet of what we can provide:
```
- VPC peering + private endpoints
- BYO-KMS: key-wrap via AWS CloudHSM/customer KMS
- Dedicated capacity: 8x A100s (reserve)
```
james (Security Eng): On SOC2 / attestation: we can provide our SOC2 report and SOC2 in-scope controls. For their HSM attestation we need the vendor-supplied cert (customer side) or an integration confirmation. I'll need the exact ask from their security questionnaire — can someone paste Qs?
nina (Prod Eng): Capacity comment: if they really need sustained 1B tokens/day we should price as reserved throughput; bursts will be capped by per-region pool. Ops ETA to provision extra pool is ~3 business days after PO. we should avoid ephemeral scale during the POC.
kate (Legal): For BYO-KMS + rotation, contract language we normally use: "Customer retains control of encryption keys; Redwood has no access to unencrypted customer data." Need to confirm insurance clause and egress restrictions. I can draft an amendment (SLA + KMS addendum) once we have the final tech spec.
mia (AE): Customer sent two pages from their security team; pasted key lines in thread (redacted): "requires HSM attestation, key rotation policy, and proof of crypto key isolation." They want an exec-level response today for their board.
ops-bot: Provisioning request #PR-98123 queued by arnav. Status: pending approval from eng-infra.
oliver (VP Sales): OK — prioritize. @nina @sofia can you confirm if we can run a temporary Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for a 72h window (isolated) and estimate cost? @james @kate prepare a short exec brief: what we can commit to (SOC2 + KMS flow) and what needs customer deliverables. I want a 1-page summary for the board call by EOD.
sofia (Solutions Eng): I can draft the one-pager. Technical yes to temporary dedicated pool, but ops will need a PO + billing hold. Estimated runbook: provision day 0, validation day 1, test day 2.
james (Security Eng): I'll attach checklist items we can commit to and list gaps (HSM cert, external KMS attestation). can we ask customer to sign an NDA addendum for sharing deeper infra diagrams?
kate (Legal): NDA addendum OK. I'll prepare KMS addendum + short contract note on egress. Need customer legal contact to review — @mia can you get them on an email thread?
mia (AE): On it. looping in customer legal (cc'd in my next email). Will push for board call prep materials.
arnav (SE): Action items captured:
- ops: quota/pool prov (nina)
- eng-security: SOC2 + HSM checklist (james)
- legal: KMS addendum draft (kate)
- sales: Exec 1-pager + pricing for reserved throughput (mia/oliver/sofia)
Please update this thread with ETA.
nina (Prod Eng): Ops ETA: provision request once PO received; estimate 72h total to have pool ready; can do faster with exec approval for priority provisioning (24-36h).
oliver (VP Sales): Good. Mia, get PO or written commitment and customer contact. If they push board deadline, I'll escalate for priority provisioning.
mia (AE): Will chase. Thanks everyone — will update here. :thumbsup:
